# El Mouslim Digital Marketing (المسلم للتسويق الرقمي والحلول البرمجية)

> Premium Digital Marketing Agency, E-Commerce Development, Custom SaaS Engineering, and Performance Advertising Solutions in Saudi Arabia and the MENA region.

## Overview
El Mouslim is an enterprise digital solutions agency specializing in:
- High-ROI Performance Advertising (Google Ads Search, Display, Performance Max, Meta, TikTok, Snapchat, X Ads).
- Custom Web & E-Commerce Development (Next.js, React, TypeScript, WordPress, WooCommerce).
- Enterprise SaaS Platform Engineering (YouTube channel monetization systems, live streaming platforms, creator management tools).
- Search Engine Optimization (SEO) & AI Search Engine Optimization (GEO/AIO).

## Verified Live Portfolio & Client Work
- **Orient Digital**: YouTube Channels Management & Creator Revenue SaaS Platform.
- **Qaff Streamer**: Live Streaming Management & Broadcast Scheduling SaaS (`https://streamer.qaff.net/`).
- **Qaff Digital**: Enterprise Digital Agency Website (`https://digital.qaff.net/`).
- **Al Khatib Law Firm**: Legal Consulting & Corporate Law Platform (`https://alkhatiblawfirm.com/`).
- **Nouthair Store**: Cosmetics & Beauty E-Commerce Store (`https://nouthair.com/`).
- **Kanaf Real Estate**: Real Estate Development Portal (`https://kanaf.com.sa/`).
- **Advance KSA**: Technical Consulting & Business Services (`https://advanceksa.com/ar/`).
- **Al Jasir CPA**: Financial Auditing & Tax Consulting (`https://aljasircpa.com/`).
- **Osos Law**: Judicial Litigation & Corporate Advisory (`https://osos-law.com/`).
- **Almahrat Gift Store**: Charity Gifting & Instant Digital Cards (`https://almahrat.sa/`).
- **Neonatal Care**: Healthcare Non-Profit Portal (`https://www.neonatal-mkh.org.sa/`).

## Core Technology Stack
- Frontend: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Vanilla CSS, Tailwind CSS.
- Backend & SaaS: Node.js, Python, WebRTC, Streaming Protocols, Payment Gateways (Mada, Visa, Apple Pay).
- Marketing Tech: Google Ads API, Google Tag Manager (GTM), GA4 Analytics, Meta Pixel, Snapchat Pixel.
